# Governed visual font fixtures

`open/` contains the exact 81 redistributable font files used by the existing approved-font inventory. Asset IDs and SHA-256 checksums are preserved. Copyright notices are in `open/licenses/NOTICES.json`; accompanying SIL OFL, Ubuntu Font Licence, Apache 2.0 and Metropolis Unlicense texts are included. Metropolis's fixture license metadata reflects its upstream Unlicense; production asset records are untouched.

The 32 Avenir/Avenir Condensed faces are not in this repository. Their compressed inventory is stored in 50 encrypted GitHub Actions repository secrets named `LEE_FONT_FIXTURE_01` through `LEE_FONT_FIXTURE_50`, each at most 40,000 base64 characters. They are staged in five bounded environment groups to avoid OS environment-size limits. `private-bundle.json` pins the archive SHA-256 and inventory count. The restoration script verifies the archive, safe paths and every font checksum before writing files into `RUNNER_TEMP`. It never logs font bytes or secret values.

The workflow restores the private store before visual testing. The existing test-storage guards run before any fixture import or mutation. Bundled open fonts are imported first; `PLAYWRIGHT_FONT_FIXTURE_ROOT` adds the private fonts (or an explicitly authorized local source). For local tests, point that variable at the existing approved `server/data`, or the restored private store; always use free dedicated test ports and disposable test data.

No font checks, visual tolerances or test skips were changed. Linux chart references are byte-identical copies of the approved Windows vector goldens; CI compares its actual pinned-font render against them with the existing 1.5% tolerance and 0.2 threshold. They are not regenerated by CI.

Public CI artifact uploads exclude PDF/ZIP exports, font files, and Playwright trace ZIPs, which can contain embedded or fetched licensed font bytes. Full export/PDF validation still runs; only screenshots and textual inventories/diagnostics are published. Temporary private fixture material is removed at job end.

Secrets are unavailable to fork PRs. Such runs fail clearly at fixture staging rather than skipping licensed-font tests. Do not expose private font secrets through pull_request_target, logs or public artifacts. Rotation requires rebuilding the private ZIP from approved unchanged files, updating its pinned metadata, then setting all numbered secrets through stdin with `gh secret set`; never put their values in command arguments.
